stories.exam_facts: Karnaphuli Paper Mills was established in 1953 by the then Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation on 501 acres of land, with 68 acres for the factory and 433 acres for residential facilities, and it once met nearly 70 percent of the government's paper demand. phrases.English explanation: Shareholders who hold shares and vote on behalf of someone else, often to hide the real owner.
phrases.Original example 1: A business group can exert influence over a board through relatives, close associates, affiliated companies, proxy shareholders or companies linked to its interests, in addition to family members.
phrases.Original example 2: Opportunities to conceal the actual ownership structure through proxy shareholders, nominees and affiliated entities must be closed.

phrases.English explanation: How sound a bank's loans and other assets are; poor asset quality means many loans may not be repaid.
phrases.Original example 1: Bangladesh Bank is conducting an asset quality review using internationally recognised methods to assess the financial condition of the banking sector, particularly struggling banks.
phrases.Original example 2: The review, nearing completion, has revealed the extent of longstanding irregularities, poor loan management and deteriorating asset quality.
phrases.Common collocations / grammar pattern: asset quality review; deteriorating asset quality; assess asset quality
phrases.Article headline: Bangladesh Bank rolls out roadmap to restore public confidence in banks
phrases.Exam value: Core banking phrase for BCS/Bank questions on non-performing loans and bank reform.

phrases.Original example 1: He said the party was trying to undermine peace and stability by provoking clashes with law enforcement agencies.
phrases.Original example 2: Law enforcement agencies had been instructed to take firm, professional and proportionate action, he added.

phrases.Article headline: Awami League trying to undermine Bangladesh peace and stability: State Minister to diplomats

mcqs.question: Under the draft banking-law amendments, how many directors from a single family would be allowed on a bank board, down from three?
mcqs.explanation: The adviser says the draft proposes reducing the maximum number of directors from a single family from three to two.

mcqs.question: At which serial numbers of Appendix A of FEPCD-1 Circular No 17 will fabric toy and tent exporters get cash assistance?
mcqs.explanation: Bangladesh Bank clarified that exporters will get cash assistance at the rates in serial numbers 1, 2 and 5 of Appendix A of FEPCD-1 Circular No 17, dated 5 July 2026.

mcqs.question: How long is Bangladesh Bank's reform roadmap to restore public confidence in banks, and how many phases does it have?
mcqs.explanation: Bangladesh Bank set out a four-year, four-phase reform roadmap to restore stability, good governance and public trust in banks.

mcqs.question: According to the BRAC-BIGD study, how much rent does a battery-rickshaw driver in Dhaka pay on average each month out of average earnings of Tk 29,000?
mcqs.explanation: A driver earns an average of Tk 29,000 a month and pays Tk 10,323 of it, 38.6 per cent, in rent to the rickshaw owner.

mcqs.question: According to the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, what is the computer usage rate in Bangladesh cited in the NEIR column?
mcqs.explanation: The column says that according to the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, the computer usage rate in the country stands at just 11.8%.

mcqs.question: What monthly dollar shortage has stalled interbank dollar trading in Bangladesh?
mcqs.explanation: Bangladesh faces a monthly $1 billion dollar shortage that has stalled interbank dollar trading.

mcqs.question: How many incidents of violence at how many locations did the government record between 1 and 21 November, according to the state minister?
mcqs.explanation: The state minister said the government had recorded 158 incidents of violence at 41 locations between 1 and 21 November.

mcqs.question: How many Grameen Bank branches did Muhammad Yunus allege had been attacked with petrol bombs, out of more than 2,500 branches?
mcqs.explanation: Yunus alleged that nearly 100 branches of Grameen Bank have been attacked with petrol bombs, out of more than 2,500 branches nationwide.

mcqs.question: By about how much has Karnaphuli Paper Mills' annual production fallen from around 20,000 tonnes 15 years ago to about 3,000 tonnes now?
mcqs.explanation: The mill, which produced around 20,000 tonnes a year 15 years ago, now produces only about 3,000 tonnes, a decline of about 87%.

mcqs.question: Who is the editor of 'AI for the Global South: A Quarterly Bulletin', Bangladesh's first AI-focused quarterly bulletin?
mcqs.explanation: Masud Jamil Khan, editor of the bulletin and president of the Eelaia Foundation, said it aims to become a milestone in AI education.

mcqs.question: Under the Special Solar Power Installation Ordinance, 2026, what is the time-bound export incentive for rooftop solar?
mcqs.explanation: The ordinance offers a time-bound Tk10.5/kWh export incentive for rooftop solar.

mcqs.question: On how many economies in all is the United States preparing new tariffs, according to the report?
mcqs.explanation: The United States is preparing new tariffs on China, the European Union and 14 other economies -- 16 in all.

mcqs.question: What minimum monthly wage for garment workers was set by the Minimum Wage Board, effective from December?
mcqs.explanation: The minimum monthly wage for garment workers has been set at Tk17,000 after a 4-2 vote, effective from December. Tk18,000 was the workers' demand and Tk21,500 is the Grade 1 wage.

mcqs.question: What does 'oligarchic' mean in the phrase 'break this oligarchic control'?

options.D: Control by a few powerful families

mcqs.explanation: Oligarchic means relating to rule by a small group of powerful people; here it is family and business-group control of bank boards.

mcqs.question: In the draft banking amendments, what is being cut from 12 years to six years?

options.A: The break a director must take
options.C: The term of the Bank Company Act
options.D: The age limit for bank directors

mcqs.explanation: The draft proposes reducing the maximum consecutive tenure of a director from 12 years to six.

mcqs.question: What does 'conceal' mean in 'Opportunities to conceal the actual ownership structure ... must be closed'?
mcqs.explanation: Conceal means to hide something so it cannot be seen or known; here, hiding who really owns a bank.

mcqs.question: Who are 'proxy shareholders' in the banking article?

options.B: Shareholders who own the largest single stake
options.D: Shareholders who have sold all their shares

mcqs.explanation: A proxy is a person authorised to act for another; proxy shareholders hold shares and vote for the real owner behind them.

mcqs.question: What did Bangladesh Bank issue about cash assistance for fabric toy and tent exports?

options.A: A new tax on toy exports

mcqs.explanation: The Foreign Exchange Policy Department issued the clarification in a notice on 24 November, setting out the applicable cash assistance rates.

mcqs.question: What does 'deteriorating asset quality' mean in the Bangladesh Bank story?

options.A: Asset quality that is improving fast
options.B: Asset quality that is becoming worse
options.D: Asset quality that is fully audited

mcqs.explanation: Deteriorating means becoming worse over time; the review found poor loan management and deteriorating asset quality.

mcqs.question: What does 'viability' mean in 'restore financial viability'?

options.A: A bank's ability to keep working
options.B: The size of a bank's branch network
options.C: The number of a bank's depositors
options.D: The speed of a bank's loan approvals

mcqs.explanation: Viability means the ability to work successfully or continue to exist; here, restoring a struggling bank's financial viability.

mcqs.question: What is a 'livelihood crisis' as faced by 42.2% of the rickshaw drivers surveyed?

options.A: A crisis in earning a living
options.B: A crisis in road traffic rules
options.D: A crisis in fuel prices only

mcqs.explanation: Livelihood is the way a person earns money to live; a livelihood crisis means their means of earning a living was badly hit.

mcqs.question: What does 'granular' mean in 'real-time, granular, demand-side data'?

options.A: Data collected only once a year

mcqs.explanation: Granular means very detailed, breaking something down into small, specific parts; NEIR would give granular data on smartphone ownership.

mcqs.question: In the wage story, what does Babul Akter mean by saying the Tk4,500 increase 'was not insignificant'?

options.D: The increase was larger than Tk18,000

mcqs.explanation: Insignificant means too small or unimportant to matter, so 'not insignificant' means the increase was not unimportant.

mcqs.question: What is 'cash assistance' in the Bangladesh Bank story?

options.A: A loan that exporters must repay with interest
options.B: A tax charged on fabric toy exports
options.D: A fine imposed on banks for late payments

mcqs.explanation: Cash assistance is money paid by the government to exporters as support; fabric toy and tent exporters receive it at the rates in Appendix A.

mcqs.question: Why do 'trade agreements' matter in the US tariffs story?

options.A: Countries with trade agreements face higher tariffs
options.B: Countries without trade agreements are exempt
options.C: Steel and aluminium are covered by them
options.D: Deal partners may face tariffs capped near 15%

mcqs.explanation: Countries that have previously reached trade agreements with Washington, including Japan and the EU, may face tariffs capped at around 15% or lower, while those without agreements face higher rates.
